data.name: Beram
data.gender_notes: Beram is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ber' meaning 'light, bright'. In Islamic history, Beram is associated with the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) companions and their enlightened wisdom. The name Beram carries the meaning “Light, Bright” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Beram usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and wisdom.
data.etymology: Beram belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Beram total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
